scientific_integrity: Claim is supported by an explicit Markov partition count, exact symmetric Jacobi reduction and a variational Airy-limit proof; numerical checks are only diagnostics.
scientific_limitations: Initial bounded-block survivors only; no all-period census, no uniform remainder, no generic cutoff independence. Related generic extreme-zero asymptotics may affect priority.
title: An Airy-edge law for finite-survivor entropy in a mixing infinite-entropy interval map
